description:
PROBLEM TYPE: LP

PROBLEM INFO:

- A delivery person starts at the intersection of \var{1}th Avenue and \var{1}th Street and needs to reach the intersection of \var{W}th Avenue and \var{N}th Street.
- The path between these two points forms a \var{N-1} × \var{W-1} grid.
- Each block on the grid has a unique walking time due to varying pedestrian traffic during rush hour.
- The delivery person can only walk north or west.
- The journey can be broken down into \var{m} stages, where at each stage the delivery person decides to walk either north or west.
- When at the intersection of \var{w}th Avenue and \var{n}th Street, the time to move to the intersection of \var{w+1}th Avenue and \var{n}th Stree is \var{west_time_{n,w}}.
- When at the intersection of \var{w}th Avenue and \var{n}th Street, the time to move to the intersection of \var{w}th Avenue and \var{n+1}th Stree is \var{north_time_{n,w}}.

INPUT FORMAT:

{
    "west_time": [[west_{n,w} for w in 1, ..., W-1] for n in 1, ..., N],
    "north_time": [[north_{n,w} for w in 1, ..., W] for n in 1, ..., N-1],
}

OBJECTIVE: Determine the optimal path the delivery person should take to ensure the package is delivered in the least amount of time.

OUTPUT INFO:

- \var{total_time} represents total time taken to travel this path
- \var{paths} represents the flow going through the corresponding path

OUTPUT FORMAT:

{
    "paths": [(street_{n}, avenue_{w}) for id in 1, ..., m]
    "total_time": total_travel_time
}

WestTime.definition: Time to cross street segment going west, for given street n and segment w

NorthTime.definition: Time to cross street segment going north, for given street n and segment w

objective.description: Minimize the total travel time required for the delivery person to reach the intersection of Wth Avenue and Nth Street from the starting point.
objective.code:
model.setObjective(
    quicksum(WestTime[n][w] * xWest[n, w] for n in range(N) for w in range(W-1)) +
    quicksum(NorthTime[n][w] * xNorth[n, w] for n in range(N-1) for w in range(W)),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

constraints.description: Flow conservation at each intersection (n,w): total inflow minus total outflow equals 0 for all intermediate nodes, equals -1 at the starting intersection (1,1), and equals 1 at the destination intersection (N,W)
constraints.formulation:
$\forall n = 1,\dots,N,\; \forall w = 1,\dots,W:\\
\left( \mathbb{1}_{w>1} \, xWest[n,w-1] + \mathbb{1}_{n>1} \, xNorth[n-1,w] \right)
- \left( \mathbb{1}_{w<W} \, xWest[n,w] + \mathbb{1}_{n<N} \, xNorth[n,w] \right)
=
\begin{cases}
-1 & \text{if } (n,w) = (1,1), \\
1 & \text{if } (n,w) = (N,W), \\
0 & \text{otherwise.}
\end{cases}$

constraints.description: Flow on each allowed street segment (northward or westward) must be non-negative
constraints.formulation: $\\forall n = 1, \\dots, N,\\; \\forall w = 1, \\dots, W-1:\\; xWest[n,w] \\ge 0 \\quad \\text{and} \\quad \\forall n = 1, \\dots, N-1,\\; \\forall w = 1, \\dots, W:\\; xNorth[n,w] \\ge 0$

xWest.definition: Flow on the west-directed arc from intersection (n,w) to (n,w+1)

xNorth.definition: Flow on the north-directed arc from intersection (n,w) to (n+1,w)
